capabilities.name: Phase 1 durable research mission and truthful pre-call report
sharedInvariants: Every manual lead starts or resumes one durable bounded research mission.
Operator-entered jurisdiction constraints remain immutable unless the owner explicitly corrects them.
Contradictory or insufficiently associated evidence is quarantined and cannot influence canonical facts, comps, valuation, score, strategy, or the report.
A pre-call report is ready only with verified parcel facts, a parcel-associated visual, qualified sold comps, a sourced market fact, and a Land Score.
Sold land comparables must pass status, age, distance, acreage/type similarity, price, and provenance gates; listings remain context only.
Transcript upload remains downstream of pre-call property research.
LandPortal API and MCP paths remain off-limits; paid actions and offer or contract sending remain prohibited.
browserAssertions: Mission Control, Acquisitions, and Jarvis navigation stays shell-free and retains one application browser tab.
The canonical Deal Card discloses a quarantined research mission as needing parcel confirmation, states that no rejected parcel evidence was promoted, and offers an explicit operator re-run control.

An unresolved lead's canonical Deal Card is truthful: the Property Summary honestly reports it is not built, unconfirmed facts are marked unconfirmed, Smart Intake stays available, and no readiness claim or paid/outbound action appears.
Unqualified comp rows never appear in the valuation set and unsupported strategies render only as validation hypotheses.
Truthful state persists through refresh and canonical managed restart.
knownLimitations: Re-baselined 2026-07-24 under Tyler's direction: journeys phase1-verified-research-mission and phase1-unresolved-discovery-package asserted the retired Lead Workspace mission/discovery-package panels (OBS-1) and are replaced by research-quarantine-honesty and unresolved-lead-truthful-card on the canonical Deal Card - see docs/landos/Lead_Workspace_Rebaseline_2026-07-24.md.

The mutation-gated journeys phase1-manual-lead-promotion and phase1-transcript-reconciliation (not registry-protected) still reference retired Lead Workspace selectors and need their own mutation-approved re-baseline session before they can run.
Operating lead 25 remains unresolved because the available evidence did not establish the exact parcel; the report correctly exposes this rather than fabricating research.
An authentic seller discovery call and the owner's usefulness judgment remain outside this correctness-repair sprint.
